user.title: Create a managed temporary user
user.description: This creates a dedicated non-admin Home Assistant user with a deny-by-default entity whitelist. An empty whitelist grants no entity access. Only the Owner can reveal or change its password from the card.

init.title: Temporary Guest schedule and entity access
init.description: Changing either entity list immediately revokes the guest's sessions and applies a server-side deny-by-default policy. Empty lists grant no entity access.
